entries.dialogueText: Upon seeing me, he smiled and opened his arms.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Comrade Rayne. I am planning on in..."
entries.dialogueText: “Comrade Rayne. I am planning on invading Heljiland to save Valgslandian people from the clutches of the murderous Agnolian governor.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Don't worry. I don't wish to pull..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't worry. I don't wish to pull Sordland into this conflict in any way.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Very well. I won't push further.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well. I won't push further.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“This is not your battle, after all..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is not your battle, after all.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Comrade Malenyev is a good friend..."
entries.dialogueText: “Comrade Malenyev is a good friend of mine.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“What I want from you is simple.”"
entries.dialogueText: “What I want from you is simple.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We hugged and he patted me on the s..."
entries.dialogueText: We hugged and he patted me on the shoulder.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I want you to recognize Heljiland..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want you to recognize Heljiland as Valgslandian territory.”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “Let's hope we can stay that way.”
entries.menuText: “Let's hope we can stay that way.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“What do you say, Comrade Rayne? Ar..."
entries.dialogueText: “What do you say, Comrade Rayne? Are you with me? I will also provide some minor financial assistance as a fellow traveller.”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “I won't meddle in the affairs between Valgsland and Agnolia.”
entries.menuText: “I won't meddle in the affairs between Valgsland and Agnolia.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I am with you, Comrade Hegel.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I am with you, Comrade Hegel.”
entries.menuText: “I am with you, Comrade Hegel.” [+1 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Please, Comrade Hegel. You must re..."
entries.dialogueText: “Please, Comrade Hegel. You must remain calm. So many lives would be lost.”
entries.menuText: “Please, Comrade Hegel. You must remain calm. So many lives would be lost.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Comrade Rayne! It is so good to se..."
entries.dialogueText: “Comrade Rayne! It is so good to see you. I've wanted to meet you in person for a long time.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Although I don't agree with him on..."
entries.dialogueText: “Although I don't agree with him on every matter, he demands respect.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“There are two things on my mind.”"
entries.dialogueText: “There are two things on my mind.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“So many Valgslandian lives are alr..."
entries.dialogueText: “So many Valgslandian lives are already lost!”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“However, our revolution here in Va..."
entries.dialogueText: “However, our revolution here in Valgsland owes a great deal to Malenyev. He is the father of Malenyevism and a symbol of global revolution.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Very well. I will take that as a n..."
entries.dialogueText: “Very well. I will take that as a no.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So. Where do we begin?”"
entries.dialogueText: “So. Where do we begin?”
entries.menuText: “So. Where do we begin?”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Although I would appreciate the su..."
entries.dialogueText: “Although I would appreciate the support, our matters are not yours.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Likewise.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Likewise.”
entries.menuText: “Likewise.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I will commence the invasion regar..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will commence the invasion regardless.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's a pleasure to finally meet wi..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's a pleasure to finally meet with you.”
entries.menuText: “It's a pleasure to finally meet with you.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Then it is time!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Then it is time!”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“If we have Sordland behind our cau..."
entries.dialogueText: “If we have Sordland behind our cause, everything will be easier.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Ah. You have spotted the portrait...."
entries.dialogueText: “Ah. You have spotted the portrait. Well. Where do I begin?”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“So you'd prefer to stay neutral.”"
entries.dialogueText: “So you'd prefer to stay neutral.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Comrade Rayne. If you'd like, I ca..."
entries.dialogueText: “Comrade Rayne. If you'd like, I can put in a good word for you with Comrade Malenyev. I have the feeling you would get along with him.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Very well. I respect that.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well. I respect that.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured towards the painting."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured towards the painting.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Although I would appreciate the su..."
entries.dialogueText: “Although I would appreciate the support, as you said, our matters are not yours.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hegel looked down for a moment. He..."
entries.dialogueText: Hegel looked down for a moment. He walked over to the window and gazed outside, his arms crossed behind his back.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“This was made in 1776 by the famou..."
entries.dialogueText: “This was made in 1776 by the famous Valgslandian painter, Otto Kiebern.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“We have achieved a lot today, Comr..."
entries.dialogueText: “We have achieved a lot today, Comrade Rayne.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Would you like that?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Would you like that?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The assistant immediately showed up..."
entries.dialogueText: The assistant immediately showed up with two more shots of vodka.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Another!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Another!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked at the painting. It must'v..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked at the painting. It must've been over five meters tall. It was a battle scene. On the left side, there were banners carried by Valgs; on the right, Sords.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What can you tell me about Comrade..."
entries.dialogueText: “What can you tell me about Comrade Malenyev?”
entries.menuText: “What can you tell me about Comrade Malenyev?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We gulped down the shots after clin..."
entries.dialogueText: We gulped down the shots after clinking.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Countless spears formed a triangle..."
entries.dialogueText: Countless spears formed a triangle at the center. The sky was red from the blood.

entries.dialogueText: “What do you think about it?”

entries.dialogueText: As the assistant collected the empty glasses, he whispered into Hegel's ear.

entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for the offer, but there is no need.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you for the offer, but there is no need.”

entries.dialogueText: His eyes widened and he clenched his fists in anger.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“The Agnolians did what?!”"
entries.dialogueText: “The Agnolians did what?!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It is a reminder. One misstep and..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is a reminder. One misstep and we are back to painting the world with more blood.”
entries.menuText: “It is a reminder. One misstep and we are back to painting the world with more blood.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He composed himself and smiled at m..."
entries.dialogueText: He composed himself and smiled at me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Nothing. It's just a painting.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Nothing. It's just a painting.”
entries.menuText: “Nothing. It's just a painting.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Comrade Rayne, I'm afraid you will..."
entries.dialogueText: “Comrade Rayne, I'm afraid you will have to excuse me. There is a matter I need to attend to.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I think that we have come far. Aft..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think that we have come far. After all, we are standing here side by side instead of facing each other a battlefield.”
entries.menuText: “I think that we have come far. After all, we are standing here side by side instead of facing each other a battlefield.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good luck.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good luck.”
entries.menuText: “Good luck.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Is there anything I can help with?..."
entries.dialogueText: “Is there anything I can help with?”
entries.menuText: “Is there anything I can help with?”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “Of course, Comrade Hegel. It was a pleasure.”

entries.dialogueText: “Sorry about that. You know how it is.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Thank you for the offer, but no.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for the offer, but no.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smoked bear meat, a local delicacy,..."
entries.dialogueText: Smoked bear meat, a local delicacy, was served with eggs. After a very delicious meal we sat down on two couches. I immediately saw the portrait of Leon "Malenyev" Chavatangakwunua staring down at me.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“As the leaders of this world, we m..."
entries.dialogueText: “As the leaders of this world, we must be careful, Comrade Rayne.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Certainly a fair viewpoint, Comrad..."
entries.dialogueText: “Certainly a fair viewpoint, Comrade Rayne.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“We can do so much more through uni..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can do so much more through unity, Comrade Rayne.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Have a good day and enjoy Haelm.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Have a good day and enjoy Haelm.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Very well.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Especially around those who are wi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Especially around those who are willing and ready to do precisely that.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We shook hands and Hegel left in a..."
entries.dialogueText: We shook hands and Hegel left in a hurry.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to me."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We made our way to the exquisite di..."
entries.dialogueText: We made our way to the exquisite dining room. I looked around at the tableware. Everything seemed to be colored gold, blue and white.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to me and put his hand on..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to me and put his hand on my shoulder.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“If they want to mess with Valgslan..."
entries.dialogueText: “If they want to mess with Valgsland, they will see our might!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Two cups of coffee were brought by..."
entries.dialogueText: Two cups of coffee were brought by an assistant. I took a sip while he lit his pipe.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We started walking."
entries.dialogueText: We started walking.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I don't understand your reasoning,..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't understand your reasoning, but perhaps you are right.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I do not know how much longer I ca..."
entries.dialogueText: “I do not know how much longer I can show restraint."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“How can I stay calm?”"
entries.dialogueText: “How can I stay calm?”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Agnolia clearly wants war.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Agnolia clearly wants war.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“To me, this painting tells me how..."
entries.dialogueText: “To me, this painting tells me how far we have come. Sords and Valgs may have had our troubles, but ultimately, we are brothers."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Let's begin, then.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's begin, then.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“The window for diplomatic action i..."
entries.dialogueText: “The window for diplomatic action is closing, Comrade Rayne.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“No two countries in this world und..."
entries.dialogueText: “No two countries in this world understand each other more.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Follow me. We will have a short br..."
entries.dialogueText: “Follow me. We will have a short breakfast.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Now, before you say anything...”"
entries.dialogueText: “Now, before you say anything...”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Valgsland is being attacked!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Valgsland is being attacked!”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Exactly!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Exactly!”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Middle way?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Middle way?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I would slaughter them the same wa..."
entries.dialogueText: “I would slaughter them the same way they slaughtered us!”
entries.menuText: “I would slaughter them the same way they slaughtered us!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Comrade Hegel. I urge you to remai..."
entries.dialogueText: “Comrade Hegel. I urge you to remain calm. No one wants war.”
entries.menuText: “Comrade Hegel. I urge you to remain calm. No one wants war.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I would approach the matter diplom..."
entries.dialogueText: “I would approach the matter diplomatically. Surely a middle way can be found.”
entries.menuText: “I would approach the matter diplomatically. Surely a middle way can be found.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I think you and I are like-minded..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think you and I are like-minded people, Comrade Rayne.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It is great to hear these importan..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is great to hear these important words coming from you.”
entries.menuText: “It is great to hear these important words coming from you.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After receiving the order, the guar..."
entries.dialogueText: After receiving the order, the guard hastily left. Hegel walked over to me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Exactly my thoughts.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Exactly my thoughts.”
entries.menuText: “Exactly my thoughts.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I think you will be glad to hear t..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think you will be glad to hear that I accept the deal.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I would like to solidify our newfo..."
entries.dialogueText: “I would like to solidify our newfound friendship and admiration with a military alliance between Valgsland and Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Imagine they did that to the Sordi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Imagine they did that to the Sordish people. What would you do, Comrade Rayne?”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“What do you say, Comrade Rayne? Ar..."
entries.dialogueText: “What do you say, Comrade Rayne? Are you ready to achieve greatness with me?”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“As if their occupation is not enou..."
entries.dialogueText: “As if their occupation is not enough, they kill my people in their homes in Heljiland. Slaughtering them like mere cattle.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded and pointed towards anoth..."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded and pointed towards another painting that was almost as large as the first one. A burning city was depicted. Looking closer, I realized it was Conriat.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I have had it with those damn Agno..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have had it with those damn Agnolians who claim *our* land as their own.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I am sure we will.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I am sure we will.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Now that we are allies, I must tel..."
entries.dialogueText: “Now that we are allies, I must tell you something.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Revolution is a slow process, Comr..."
entries.dialogueText: “Revolution is a slow process, Comrade Rayne. Slow but sure.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Now that that's out of the way.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Now that that's out of the way.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pointed towards another painting..."
entries.dialogueText: He pointed towards another painting that was almost as large as the first one. A burning city was depicted. Looking closer, I realized it was Conriat.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I had my doubts in the beginning,..."
entries.dialogueText: “I had my doubts in the beginning, but they disappeared once I met you in person.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The strong bite of alcohol turned i..."
entries.dialogueText: The strong bite of alcohol turned into a sweeter aftertaste.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“A pact that connects our two natio..."
entries.dialogueText: “A pact that connects our two nations. No! It's much more than that.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We clinked the glasses and drank ou..."
entries.dialogueText: We clinked the glasses and drank our shots.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“The Great Fire of Conriat.”"
entries.dialogueText: “The Great Fire of Conriat.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“In Valgsland we drink on a contrac..."
entries.dialogueText: “In Valgsland we drink on a contract, Comrade Rayne.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“No one can exploit our people and..."
entries.dialogueText: “No one can exploit our people and expect to get away with it.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He called out to a nearby assistant..."
entries.dialogueText: He called out to a nearby assistant. A moment later, the assistant returned with two shots of vodka.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“The most shameful event in all of..."
entries.dialogueText: “The most shameful event in all of Valgslandian history. The scars of it must still sting.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Sure.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sure.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Very generous. Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very generous. Thank you.”
entries.menuText: “Very generous. Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What doubts did you have?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What doubts did you have?”
entries.menuText: “What doubts did you have?”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Most excellent!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Most excellent!”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I think it is time to bury the hat..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think it is time to bury the hatchet. But I also understand where you are coming from.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The same goes for me too, Comrade..."
entries.dialogueText: “The same goes for me too, Comrade Hegel. Thank you.”
entries.menuText: “The same goes for me too, Comrade Hegel. Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Past is past. We need to look into..."
entries.dialogueText: “Past is past. We need to look into the future.”
entries.menuText: “Past is past. We need to look into the future.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Another result of the evils of imp..."
entries.dialogueText: “Another result of the evils of imperialism.”
entries.menuText: “Another result of the evils of imperialism.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You make good points, Comrade Hege..."
entries.dialogueText: “You make good points, Comrade Hegel. Very well. I accept!”
entries.menuText: “You make good points, Comrade Hegel. Very well. I accept!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sordland can protect itself agains..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sordland can protect itself against threats. I will have to refuse.”
entries.menuText: “Sordland can protect itself against threats. I will have to refuse.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We will never forget the extremely..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will never forget the extremely shameful display by the Valgslandian navy. ”
entries.menuText: “We will never forget the extremely shameful display by the Valgslandian navy. ”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“A director of a foreign joint-vent..."
entries.dialogueText: “A director of a foreign joint-venture mining corporation decided not to pay his miners their salary for two consecutive months. He will be handled.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Are you sure about this, Comrade R..."
entries.dialogueText: “Are you sure about this, Comrade Rayne?”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“A sign that unity between Valgs an..."
entries.dialogueText: “A sign that unity between Valgs and Sords has finally arrived!”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I am offering a helping hand.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I am offering a helping hand.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Give the miners what they want. As..."
entries.dialogueText: “Give the miners what they want. As for the director of the company, I want him to face a trial for undermining the workers of Valgsland. Relay it to the Minister of Justice at once!”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“If you want to protect your countr..."
entries.dialogueText: “If you want to protect your country against what might come next, you will need allies.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“We will never forget the sins of o..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will never forget the sins of our fathers.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“As you know, the rogue state of Ru..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you know, the rogue state of Rumburg is on the move.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Well said, Comrade Rayne.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Well said, Comrade Rayne.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I agree completely.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I agree completely.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“No. Thank you, Comrade Rayne.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No. Thank you, Comrade Rayne.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Our two countries have never been..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our two countries have never been closer.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Nothing you should worry about.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Nothing you should worry about.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“What's a deal or two between Valgs..."
entries.dialogueText: “What's a deal or two between Valgsland and Sordland? We have so much more possibility between our countries.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“If it tips to the wrong side, Valg..."
entries.dialogueText: “If it tips to the wrong side, Valgsland may be your only way out.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sordland is part of a fragile bala..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sordland is part of a fragile balance. I don't want to disturb it."
entries.menuText: “Sordland is part of a fragile balance. I don't want to disturb it."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“If not now, when?”"
entries.dialogueText: “If not now, when?”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Thankfully, we in Valgsland have n..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thankfully, we in Valgsland have now cut off the head of the snake called imperialism.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I definitely do.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I definitely do.”
entries.menuText: “I definitely do.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A guard approached the Chancellor."
entries.dialogueText: A guard approached the Chancellor.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“You yourself say that balance is f..."
entries.dialogueText: “You yourself say that balance is fragile. It will tip no matter what you do.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“So you say.”"
entries.dialogueText: “So you say.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I say the time is now.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I say the time is now.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What was that about?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What was that about?”
entries.menuText: “What was that about?”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“If you will excuse me for one minu..."
entries.dialogueText: “If you will excuse me for one minute.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's move on with the scheduled p..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's move on with the scheduled program.”
entries.menuText: “Let's move on with the scheduled program.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“What did you say?!”"
entries.dialogueText: “What did you say?!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Although I am ready, Sordland is n..."
entries.dialogueText: “Although I am ready, Sordland is not. Our countries' past still haunts the minds of my people.”
entries.menuText: “Although I am ready, Sordland is not. Our countries' past still haunts the minds of my people.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“If an alliance happens, I want it..."
entries.dialogueText: “If an alliance happens, I want it to happen on my terms and at a more opportune time.”
entries.menuText: “If an alliance happens, I want it to happen on my terms and at a more opportune time.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The chancellor stepped away with th..."
entries.dialogueText: The chancellor stepped away with the guard while I looked around. I saw a more recent painting, depicting the upheaval of farmers against an aristocrat.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I will sign the papers shortly.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I will sign the papers shortly.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hegel's loud voice echoed in the em..."
entries.dialogueText: Hegel's loud voice echoed in the empty halls.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“And why is that, Comrade Rayne?”"
entries.dialogueText: “And why is that, Comrade Rayne?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He clenched his fist and looked at..."
entries.dialogueText: He clenched his fist and looked at me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I accept, Comrade Hegel. May this..."
entries.dialogueText: “I accept, Comrade Hegel. May this brighten the future of both of our countries!”
entries.menuText: “I accept, Comrade Hegel. May this brighten the future of both of our countries!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you for the offer, Comrade H..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for the offer, Comrade Hegel. However, I will have to refuse.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you for the offer, Comrade Hegel. However, I will have to refuse.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He got up from his seat, walked ove..."
entries.dialogueText: He got up from his seat, walked over to the window and looked outside.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I hear there is still an emergency..."
entries.dialogueText: “I hear there is still an emergency declared in Sordland.”

entries.dialogueText: “I hope everything is alright.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Nothing to worry about, Comrade He..."
entries.dialogueText: “Nothing to worry about, Comrade Hegel. Everything has been handled.”
entries.menuText: “Nothing to worry about, Comrade Hegel. Everything has been handled.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That is none of your concern, Comr..."
entries.dialogueText: “That is none of your concern, Comrade Hegel.”
entries.menuText: “That is none of your concern, Comrade Hegel.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's change the topic.”"

entries.menuText: “Let's change the topic.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“No need to go on the defensive.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No need to go on the defensive.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“I get the signal, Comrade Rayne.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I get the signal, Comrade Rayne.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Very well.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Valgslandian Socialism aims to eli..."
entries.dialogueText: “Valgslandian Socialism aims to eliminate the power of the state by promoting the responsibility, freedom and well-being of the people. One of our key cornerstones is the devolution of big government to smaller councils with high citizen participation.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“We believe that the revolution in..."
entries.dialogueText: “We believe that the revolution in Valgsland is stable enough that we do not need the vanguardist approach of Malenyevism. We are already in the process of such a transformation.”

entries.title: Narrator: "Hegel looked down for a moment. He..."
entries.dialogueText: Hegel looked down for a moment. He walked over to the window and gazed outside, his arms crossed behind his back.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Even if you're not with us, I will..."
entries.dialogueText: “Even if you're not with us, I will tell you something you may want to know.”
